signature.why: The two cards that ARE the deck, 4-of in 10/10 field lists: a one-mana instant that returns a legendary creature, and the seven-drop it returns. Nothing else in Modern puts an Atraxa onto the battlefield on turn two at instant speed.

The discard outlets that get Atraxa into the graveyard, and the hand attack that buys the turn. Psychic Frog is 4-of in 10/10 - it is the outlet, the clock and the card advantage at once - and which of the others fill the rest is a build decision.

An esper fetch-and-shock manabase. Goryo's Vengeance wants {B}, Solitude and Prismatic Ending want {W} and Faithful Mending wants {U} on the same turns, which is why every field list plays eight or more of these nine.
